narration: Deep in the sparkling ocean lived a tiny fish named Glimmerfish — and she had the brightest glow in the whole sea!
One morning, she spotted something strange on the ocean floor — a big glowing star, just sitting in the sand!
She tried to lift it — but it was SO heavy! She wiggled and wobbled and spun in circles, but the star didn't budge!
Then Glimmerfish had a brilliant idea! She called ALL her friends — the crab, the seahorse, and even a giant friendly jellyfish — and together they pushed… and up, up, UP the star floated!
